request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field.

failures.intro: **Server bug:** the handler does not declare `player`. The name resolves to the `var player` of the connection function (node/server.js:4991). That variable is set only when the socket connected with a `secret` handshake query and some character was online. Then it is the last character that the loop read, which can be a different character.

rows.when: The variable `player` is `undefined`: the socket connected without a `secret` query (the usual case), or no character was online then. `player.monster` throws.

confirm.note: `var player` at 4991 is scoped to the connection function (4859); the handler has no `var player` of its own

rows.when: `player` is a character with no `monster`. That is always true, because `pet` never makes one.
